instruction.text: Complete the sentence by writing the correct spelling of the word in the gap.

atoms.b: Doctors ((recommend)) that you eat your five a day.
atoms.finishSound: Doctors recommend that you eat your five a day.

atoms.b: Parking in the street is the ((privilege)) of residents only.
atoms.finishSound: Parking in the street is the privilege of residents only.

atoms.b: She was ((sincerely)) grateful for the help.
atoms.finishSound: She was sincerely grateful for the help.
Every vegetable has a different flavour.

atoms.b: Far be it from me to ((criticise)) her.
atoms.finishSound: Far be it from me to criticise her.

atoms.b: The dog was a bit ((aggressive)) towards her.
atoms.finishSound: The dog was a bit aggressive towards her.
